name: Nightcap Baby Cannon Live Resin Pre-Roll | 1.3g
description: Nightcap is a relaxing indica strain made with Mendocino Purps and Deep Bubba Kush. This strain has a sweet and fruity, woody berry flavor with an exhale of sour grape candy. Similar to the flavor profile, its aroma also is spicy and earthy herbal grape with hints of woody pine. As one would expect, Nightcap is perfect for helping you unwind after a long day, relaxing you while filling you with an expansive sense of giggly euphoria.
